title: French Comprehension
topics: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: The statement “the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with” describes which of the following?
o: La conclusion
L'idée principale
Le titre
Le résumé
items.s: Le titre is the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with.

items.q: The statement “the relation shown by et, which adds one element to another” describes which of the following?
o: Le but
La concession
La condition
L'addition
items.s: L'addition is the relation shown by et, which adds one element to another.

items.q: The statement “the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it” describes which of the following?
o: L'inférence
La lecture à haute voix
La lecture approfondie
Le repérage
items.s: La lecture à haute voix is the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it.

items.q: The statement “a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense” describes which of the following?
o: Le mot-clé
L'antonyme
La périphrase
L'homonyme
items.s: L'homonyme is a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense.

items.q: L'article de journal may be defined as
o: the central claim that a passage is written to establish
the relation shown by si, which makes one event depend on another
an item that leaves the respondent free to answer at length in their own words
a piece of reporting or comment printed in a newspaper
items.s: L'article de journal: a piece of reporting or comment printed in a newspaper. The other options describe La question ouverte, La condition, L'idée principale.

items.q: Le vrai ou faux may be defined as
o: the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage
the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with
an exercise in which each statement must be marked correct or incorrect
the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something
items.s: Le vrai ou faux: an exercise in which each statement must be marked correct or incorrect. The other options describe Le titre, La justification, La cause.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines L'antécédent.
o: the indented opening of a fresh block of writing that marks a new topic
the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands
a block of connected sentences on one point, set off by an indent or a space
the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with
items.s: L'antécédent: the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands. The other options describe Le paragraphe, L'alinéa, Le titre.

items.q: Which term is described by “a roundabout way of naming something instead of using its usual word”?
o: L'antonyme
Le terme technique
La périphrase
L'homonyme
items.s: La périphrase is a roundabout way of naming something instead of using its usual word.

items.q: The statement “the opening part of a passage that announces its subject and its purpose” describes which of the following?
o: La conclusion
Le thème
L'introduction
Le titre
items.s: L'introduction is the opening part of a passage that announces its subject and its purpose.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le graphique?
o: a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense
an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer
a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change
the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something
items.s: Le graphique: a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change. The other options describe La question fermée, L'homonyme, La cause.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le sous-titre?
o: a secondary heading placed below the main one to divide a passage into sections
a word or short phrase that carries the central idea of a passage
going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift
the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech
items.s: Le sous-titre: a secondary heading placed below the main one to divide a passage into sections. The other options describe Le registre soutenu, La lecture rapide, Le mot-clé.

items.q: Which term is described by “a meaning hinted at rather than spoken out, often with a mischievous intent”?
o: L'implicite
Le sous-entendu
L'ironie
La présupposition
items.s: Le sous-entendu is a meaning hinted at rather than spoken out, often with a mischievous intent.

items.q: The statement “going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift” describes which of the following?
o: La lecture à haute voix
L'inférence
La relecture
La lecture rapide
items.s: La lecture rapide is going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift.

items.q: Le champ lexical may be defined as
o: the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to
the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage
a passage that defends a position by giving reasons and evidence for it
the set of words in a passage that all relate to one area of experience
items.s: Le champ lexical: the set of words in a passage that all relate to one area of experience. The other options describe La justification, Le référent, Le texte argumentatif.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le registre soutenu.
o: a short substitute standing for a noun already named in the passage
a message sent by electronic mail over the internet
the characteristic way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words
the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech
items.s: Le registre soutenu: the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech. The other options describe Le courriel, Le style, Le pronom de reprise.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le texte narratif.
o: a passage written as an exchange of speech between two or more people
an exercise in which each statement must be marked correct or incorrect
a passage that recounts a series of events one after another in time
a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does
items.s: Le texte narratif: a passage that recounts a series of events one after another in time. The other options describe L'annonce, Le texte dialogué, Le vrai ou faux.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: Le référent may be defined as
o: a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change
the broad subject that a passage deals with throughout
an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer
the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to
items.s: Le référent: the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to. The other options describe Le graphique, Le thème, La question fermée.

items.q: All of the following belong to Identifying the main idea EXCEPT
o: Le thème
Le titre
Le texte dialogué
L'idée principale
items.s: Every other option belongs to Identifying the main idea. “Le texte dialogué” belongs to Types of text and reading purpose, not Identifying the main idea.

items.q: The statement “the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech” describes which of the following?
o: La dénotation
Le destinataire
Le style
Le registre soutenu
items.s: Le registre soutenu is the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech.

items.q: Which term is described by “the relaxed level of language used among close friends and family”?
o: Le style
La connotation
La dénotation
Le registre familier
items.s: Le registre familier is the relaxed level of language used among close friends and family.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le mode d'emploi.
o: the instructions that explain how to use a device or carry out a procedure
an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for
the central claim that a passage is written to establish
the opening part of a passage that announces its subject and its purpose
items.s: Le mode d'emploi: the instructions that explain how to use a device or carry out a procedure. The other options describe L'idée principale, La présupposition, L'introduction.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La lecture rapide.
o: a short stretch copied word for word from a passage and shown as borrowed
the relation shown by bien que, which admits a fact that tells against one's own claim
the rapid going over of a passage to pick out one particular item of information
going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift
items.s: La lecture rapide: going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift. The other options describe La citation, La lecture sélective, La concession.

items.q: Which of the following best describes L'annonce?
o: the relation shown by bien que, which admits a fact that tells against one's own claim
a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change
a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does
slow and careful going through of a passage in order to understand it fully
items.s: L'annonce: a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does. The other options describe La concession, Le graphique, La lecture approfondie.

items.q: L'antécédent may be defined as
o: a linking word such as donc or mais that shows how two statements are related
a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does
the rapid going over of a passage to pick out one particular item of information
the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands
items.s: L'antécédent: the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands. The other options describe La lecture sélective, L'annonce, Le connecteur logique.

items.q: The statement “a shortened account of a passage that keeps its essential points” describes which of the following?
o: L'introduction
Le résumé
La conclusion
Le titre
items.s: Le résumé is a shortened account of a passage that keeps its essential points.

items.q: Which term is described by “what a passage suggests without stating it in so many words”?
o: Le sous-entendu
L'ironie
La présupposition
L'implicite
items.s: L'implicite is what a passage suggests without stating it in so many words.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La presse francophone?
o: a passage that defends a position by giving reasons and evidence for it
an item that leaves the respondent free to answer at length in their own words
the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique
a secondary heading placed below the main one to divide a passage into sections
items.s: La presse francophone: the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique. The other options describe Le sous-titre, La question ouverte, Le texte argumentatif.

items.q: The statement “the device of saying the opposite of what is meant for comic or critical effect” describes which of the following?
o: Le point de vue
L'intention de l'auteur
L'implicite
L'ironie
items.s: L'ironie is the device of saying the opposite of what is meant for comic or critical effect.

items.q: Which term is described by “going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift”?
o: La lecture sélective
La lecture approfondie
La lecture rapide
La lecture à haute voix
items.s: La lecture rapide is going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift.

items.q: Le destinataire may be defined as
o: the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it
a set of figures arranged in rows and columns so that they can be compared
a word or short phrase that carries the central idea of a passage
the relation shown by donc, which gives the result of something
items.s: Le destinataire: the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it. The other options describe La conséquence, Le mot-clé, Le tableau.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le texte explicatif?
o: a word proper to a specialised field, such as legal or medical vocabulary
the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands
the drawing of a conclusion from clues in a passage rather than from a stated fact
a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader
items.s: Le texte explicatif: a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader. The other options describe L'inférence, L'antécédent, Le terme technique.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: The statement “the attitude of the writer towards the subject, shown by the choice of words” describes which of the following?
o: La présupposition
L'intention de l'auteur
Le ton
Le point de vue
items.s: Le ton is the attitude of the writer towards the subject, shown by the choice of words.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'idée principale?
o: the set of words in a passage that all relate to one area of experience
a passage that recounts a series of events one after another in time
the central claim that a passage is written to establish
the drawing of a conclusion from clues in a passage rather than from a stated fact
items.s: L'idée principale: the central claim that a passage is written to establish. The other options describe Le champ lexical, L'inférence, Le texte narratif.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le texte injonctif.
o: an item that leaves the respondent free to answer at length in their own words
a passage that tells the reader what to do, as recipes and instructions do
an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for
a piece of reporting or comment printed in a newspaper
items.s: Le texte injonctif: a passage that tells the reader what to do, as recipes and instructions do. The other options describe La question ouverte, L'article de journal, La présupposition.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: L'introduction may be defined as
o: the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to
the broad subject that a passage deals with throughout
the opening part of a passage that announces its subject and its purpose
the relation shown by pour que, which gives the purpose of an action
items.s: L'introduction: the opening part of a passage that announces its subject and its purpose. The other options describe Le référent, Le thème, Le but.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines L'homonyme.
o: a block of connected sentences on one point, set off by an indent or a space
the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech
the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest
a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense
items.s: L'homonyme: a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense. The other options describe Le repérage, Le registre soutenu, Le paragraphe.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le texte narratif?
o: a passage that recounts a series of events one after another in time
the marks such as commas, stops and brackets that show how a sentence is to be read
the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands
the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it
items.s: Le texte narratif: a passage that recounts a series of events one after another in time. The other options describe La ponctuation, Le destinataire, L'antécédent.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La lecture rapide?
o: the restating of a passage in different words while keeping its sense intact
going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift
a passage that tells the reader what to do, as recipes and instructions do
the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with
items.s: La lecture rapide: going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift. The other options describe Le titre, La reformulation, Le texte injonctif.

items.q: The statement “the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands” describes which of the following?
o: Le paragraphe
L'alinéa
L'antécédent
La ponctuation
items.s: L'antécédent is the noun earlier in the sentence for which a substitute or relative word stands.

items.q: The statement “the purpose the writer hopes a passage will serve in the mind of the reader” describes which of the following?
o: Le ton
La présupposition
L'intention de l'auteur
Le point de vue
items.s: L'intention de l'auteur is the purpose the writer hopes a passage will serve in the mind of the reader.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'intention de l'auteur?
o: a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader
going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift
the purpose the writer hopes a passage will serve in the mind of the reader
a meaning hinted at rather than spoken out, often with a mischievous intent
items.s: L'intention de l'auteur: the purpose the writer hopes a passage will serve in the mind of the reader. The other options describe Le sous-entendu, Le texte explicatif, La lecture rapide.

items.q: Le terme technique may be defined as
o: a passage that sets out the appearance of a person, a place or an object
a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense
a word proper to a specialised field, such as legal or medical vocabulary
the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it
items.s: Le terme technique: a word proper to a specialised field, such as legal or medical vocabulary. The other options describe La lecture à haute voix, L'homonyme, Le texte descriptif.

items.q: Which term is described by “a passage that sets out the appearance of a person, a place or an object”?
o: Le texte narratif
Le texte argumentatif
Le texte injonctif
Le texte descriptif
items.s: Le texte descriptif is a passage that sets out the appearance of a person, a place or an object.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le destinataire.
o: the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage
a passage that sets out the appearance of a person, a place or an object
the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it
the drawing of a conclusion from clues in a passage rather than from a stated fact
items.s: Le destinataire: the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it. The other options describe Le texte descriptif, La justification, L'inférence.

items.q: The statement “the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something” describes which of the following?
o: L'opposition
La conséquence
La cause
La condition
items.s: La cause is the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something.

items.q: The statement “the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest” describes which of the following?
o: L'inférence
La lecture rapide
Le repérage
La relecture
items.s: Le repérage is the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le registre familier?
o: the relaxed level of language used among close friends and family
a set of figures arranged in rows and columns so that they can be compared
a short stretch copied word for word from a passage and shown as borrowed
an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer
items.s: Le registre familier: the relaxed level of language used among close friends and family. The other options describe La question fermée, Le tableau, La citation.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La presse francophone.
o: a linking word such as donc or mais that shows how two statements are related
a real item such as a menu, ticket or advert, studied as it stands rather than composed for learners
what a passage suggests without stating it in so many words
the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique
items.s: La presse francophone: the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique. The other options describe L'implicite, Le document authentique, Le connecteur logique.

items.q: Which term is described by “a passage that defends a position by giving reasons and evidence for it”?
o: Le texte descriptif
Le document authentique
Le texte explicatif
Le texte argumentatif
items.s: Le texte argumentatif is a passage that defends a position by giving reasons and evidence for it.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La lecture à haute voix.
o: the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique
the device of saying the opposite of what is meant for comic or critical effect
the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it
the drawing of a conclusion from clues in a passage rather than from a stated fact
items.s: La lecture à haute voix: the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it. The other options describe L'ironie, La presse francophone, L'inférence.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La relecture?
o: a second going over of a passage to settle difficult points and catch missed detail
the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to
the drawing of a conclusion from clues in a passage rather than from a stated fact
the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique
items.s: La relecture: a second going over of a passage to settle difficult points and catch missed detail. The other options describe Le référent, La presse francophone, L'inférence.

items.q: Which term is described by “a message sent by electronic mail over the internet”?
o: Le tableau
Le courriel
Le graphique
Le mode d'emploi
items.s: Le courriel is a message sent by electronic mail over the internet.

items.q: Which of the following best describes L'alinéa?
o: the indented opening of a fresh block of writing that marks a new topic
the marks such as commas, stops and brackets that show how a sentence is to be read
a word or short phrase that carries the central idea of a passage
an item that leaves the respondent free to answer at length in their own words
items.s: L'alinéa: the indented opening of a fresh block of writing that marks a new topic. The other options describe Le mot-clé, La question ouverte, La ponctuation.

items.q: Le registre soutenu may be defined as
o: a word that looks like one in another language but means something quite different
the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech
the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something
the set of words in a passage that all relate to one area of experience
items.s: Le registre soutenu: the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech. The other options describe La cause, Le faux ami, Le champ lexical.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La lecture à haute voix?
o: the relation shown by bien que, which admits a fact that tells against one's own claim
the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it
the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something
a word that carries the opposite sense to another in the same language
items.s: La lecture à haute voix: the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it. The other options describe L'antonyme, La cause, La concession.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le courriel?
o: slow and careful going through of a passage in order to understand it fully
a short stretch copied word for word from a passage and shown as borrowed
a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change
a message sent by electronic mail over the internet
items.s: Le courriel: a message sent by electronic mail over the internet. The other options describe La citation, Le graphique, La lecture approfondie.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le pronom de reprise?
o: the position from which a story is told or an opinion is advanced
a short substitute standing for a noun already named in the passage
an item that leaves the respondent free to answer at length in their own words
a second going over of a passage to settle difficult points and catch missed detail
items.s: Le pronom de reprise: a short substitute standing for a noun already named in the passage. The other options describe La question ouverte, Le point de vue, La relecture.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le fait divers?
o: a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader
a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense
the closing part of a passage that gathers its argument and states what follows
a short news item about an unusual or dramatic event in a locality
items.s: Le fait divers: a short news item about an unusual or dramatic event in a locality. The other options describe L'homonyme, La conclusion, Le texte explicatif.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La connotation?
o: a word proper to a specialised field, such as legal or medical vocabulary
the plain dictionary sense of a word apart from any feeling it carries
the additional feeling a word carries beyond its plain sense
an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for
items.s: La connotation: the additional feeling a word carries beyond its plain sense. The other options describe La présupposition, Le terme technique, La dénotation.

items.q: The statement “the central claim that a passage is written to establish” describes which of the following?
o: La conclusion
Le résumé
Le thème
L'idée principale
items.s: L'idée principale is the central claim that a passage is written to establish.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le synonyme.
o: a word that carries nearly the same sense as another in the same language
the relation shown by bien que, which admits a fact that tells against one's own claim
a piece of reporting or comment printed in a newspaper
the newspapers and magazines published in French, such as Le Monde and Jeune Afrique
items.s: Le synonyme: a word that carries nearly the same sense as another in the same language. The other options describe La concession, La presse francophone, L'article de journal.

items.q: The statement “a roundabout way of naming something instead of using its usual word” describes which of the following?
o: Le synonyme
L'antonyme
Le faux ami
La périphrase
items.s: La périphrase is a roundabout way of naming something instead of using its usual word.

items.q: Le texte explicatif may be defined as
o: a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader
the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it
the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with
the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest
items.s: Le texte explicatif: a passage that shows how or why something happens in order to inform the reader. The other options describe La lecture à haute voix, Le repérage, Le titre.
items.t: Types of text and reading purpose

items.q: Which term is described by “the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with”?
o: Le résumé
Le titre
Le sous-titre
L'introduction
items.s: Le titre is the name printed above a passage to announce what it deals with.

items.q: The statement “the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to” describes which of the following?
o: Le connecteur logique
L'alinéa
Le paragraphe
Le référent
items.s: Le référent is the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La présupposition.
o: a word pronounced or spelt like another while carrying a different sense
an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for
a passage written as an exchange of speech between two or more people
the characteristic way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words
items.s: La présupposition: an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for. The other options describe L'homonyme, Le style, Le texte dialogué.

items.q: La conséquence may be defined as
o: the neutral level of language used in ordinary conversation and everyday writing
the relation shown by donc, which gives the result of something
the indented opening of a fresh block of writing that marks a new topic
a message sent by electronic mail over the internet
items.s: La conséquence: the relation shown by donc, which gives the result of something. The other options describe L'alinéa, Le registre courant, Le courriel.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'exemple?
o: a shortened account of a passage that keeps its essential points
a passage that tells the reader what to do, as recipes and instructions do
the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech
the relation in which a particular instance is given to illustrate a general statement
items.s: L'exemple: the relation in which a particular instance is given to illustrate a general statement. The other options describe Le résumé, Le texte injonctif, Le registre soutenu.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le destinataire?
o: a passage that defends a position by giving reasons and evidence for it
the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it
the relation shown by mais, which sets two ideas against each other
the person, thing or state in the world that a word points to
items.s: Le destinataire: the person for whom a passage is written and who is expected to read it. The other options describe L'opposition, Le texte argumentatif, Le référent.

items.q: L'annonce may be defined as
o: the relation shown by parce que, which gives the reason for something
going through a whole passage quickly to grasp its general drift
a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does
an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer
items.s: L'annonce: a short public notice offering or requesting something, as a small advertisement does. The other options describe La lecture rapide, La cause, La question fermée.

items.q: The statement “a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change” describes which of the following?
o: Le tableau
L'annonce
Le graphique
La lettre formelle
items.s: Le graphique is a drawing in which bars, lines or curves show how figures change.

items.q: The statement “a block of connected sentences on one point, set off by an indent or a space” describes which of the following?
o: Le paragraphe
L'antécédent
Le connecteur logique
Le pronom de reprise
items.s: Le paragraphe is a block of connected sentences on one point, set off by an indent or a space.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines La justification.
o: the broad subject that a passage deals with throughout
the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage
what a passage suggests without stating it in so many words
a shortened account of a passage that keeps its essential points
items.s: La justification: the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage. The other options describe Le thème, Le résumé, L'implicite.

items.q: Le registre courant may be defined as
o: the relation in which a particular instance is given to illustrate a general statement

o: a short stretch copied word for word from a passage and shown as borrowed
the reason offered for a chosen answer, supported by evidence from the passage
the restating of a passage in different words while keeping its sense intact
an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer
items.s: La question fermée: an item that allows only a yes or a no as its answer. The other options describe La reformulation, La justification, La citation.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech”

Le destinataire
Le style
Le registre familier
items.s: Le registre soutenu is the polished level of language used in formal writing and public speech.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le repérage.
o: the rapid going over of a passage to pick out one particular item of information
the sounding of a passage with the voice so that listeners can follow it
slow and careful going through of a passage in order to understand it fully
the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest
items.s: Le repérage: the locating of a name, date or figure in a passage without reading the rest. The other options describe La lecture sélective, La lecture approfondie, La lecture à haute voix.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La connotation.
o: the additional feeling a word carries beyond its plain sense
the relaxed level of language used among close friends and family
the neutral level of language used in ordinary conversation and everyday writing
the characteristic way a writer shapes sentences and chooses words
items.s: La connotation: the additional feeling a word carries beyond its plain sense. The other options describe Le registre familier, Le style, Le registre courant.

La citation

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le but?

the relation shown by bien que, which admits a fact that tells against one's own claim
the relation shown by pour que, which gives the purpose of an action
the relation in which a particular instance is given to illustrate a general statement
items.s: Le but: the relation shown by pour que, which gives the purpose of an action. The other options describe La concession, L'exemple, L'addition.

o: Le texte descriptif

items.q: The correct meaning of La présupposition is

the position from which a story is told or an opinion is advanced
an assumption taken for granted in a statement and never argued for
what a passage suggests without stating it in so many words
